Executive Order
MAR 10 1939
EXEMPTION OF EDWARD B. RUSS FROM COMPULSORY RETIREMENT
FOR AGE
WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Edward B. Russ ,
Chief of the Stenographic Section, Department of State, who was exempted from
compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending February 28 , 1939 ,
by Executive Order No. 7791 of January 13 , 1938, be further exempted from such
compulsory retirement for a period of one year:
NOW, THEREFORE , by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me
by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932 , 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U. S. C., title 5 , sec .
715a ) , I hereby further exempt the said Edward B. Russ from compulsory retirement
for age for a period of one year ending February 29, 1940 .
FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT
THE WHITE HOUSE,
February 11 , 19

Executive Order
OF
JUN 8-1939
PLAVTODION
AUTHORIZING THE EXTENSION OF APPOINTMENTS OF CERTAIN EMPLOYEES
OF THE GENERAL ACCOUNTING OFFICE
By virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by the provisions of
paragraph Eighth of subdivision SECOND of section 2 of the Civil Service Act (22
Stat . 403 , 404), it is hereby ordered that the employees of the General Accounting
Office whose continuance in the service until June 30, 1939 , was authorized by
Executive Order No. 7913 of June 16 , 1938, may be further continued in the service
for a period not to extend beyond June 30, 1940 .
FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT
THE WHITE HOUSE ,
May 17, 1939 .

Executive Order
281939 D
LAWLUBRARY
POSTPONEMENT OF EFFECTIVE DATE OF CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF EXECUTIVE
ORDER NO . 6166 OF JUNE 10, 1933
WHEREAS it appears that the interests of economy require that certain transfers ,
consolidations , and eliminations provided for under section 4 of Executive Order No.
6166 of June 10 , 1933, as amended , be further delayed beyond the effective date of
that order :
NOW , THEREFORE , pursuant to the provisions of section 22 of the said order ,
I hereby order that the transfers , consolidations , and eliminations contemplated by
section 4 of Executive Order No. 6166 of June 10 , 1933 , as amended , together with the
operation of all other provisions of Executive Order No. 6166 of June 10 , 1933 , as
amended , so far as they relate to the said section 4, be further delayed until June 30 ,
1940 , with respect to the function of disbursement now exercised by United States
Marshals under the Department of Justice , and with respect to the function of dis￾bursement for the Postal Service now exercised by officers and employees of that
service .
THE WHITE HOUSE ,
June 28, 1939 .
FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT
[No. 8182]

Executive Order
SEP 5-1939
HARVARD LAW LIBRARY
EXEMPTION OF HERBERT VANSANT FROM COMPULSORY RETIREMENT
FOR AGE
WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Herbert Vansant ,
senior civil engineer , Engineer Department at Large, War Department , who , during
the month of August , 1939 , will reach the retirement age prescribed for automatic
separation from the service , applicable to him, be exempted from compulsory retire￾ment for age for a period of one year:
NOW , THEREFORE , by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me
by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932 , 47 Stat . 382 , 404 (U. S. C. , title 5 , sec .
715a ), I hereby exempt the said Herbert Vansant from compulsory retirement for
age for a period of one year ending August 31 , 1940 .
THE WHITE HOUSE ,
Aug 7th , 1939.
FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT

PROPERTY OF Executive Order OCT 4-1939
HARVARD LAW LIBRARY
EXEMPTION OF SAMUEL J. GOMPERS FROM COMPULSORY RETIREMENT
FOR AGE
WHEREAS, in my judgment , the public interest requires that Samuel J.
Gompers , Chief Clerk , Department of Labor , who was exempted from compulsory
retirement for age for a period of one year by Executive Order No. 7958 of August
19 , 1938 , be further exempted from such compulsory retirement for a period of one
year :
NOW, THEREFORE , by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in
me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932 , 47 Stat . 382 , 404 (U. S. C. , title 5 ,
sec . 715a ) , I hereby further exempt the said Samuel J. Gompers from compulsory
retirement for age for a period of one year ending September 30, 1940 .
FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT
THE WHITE HOUSE ,
September 14 , 1

GROPERTY OF
Executive Order
FEB 191940
HARVARD LAW:
EXEMPTION OF HENRY CLARKE HILL FROM COMPULSORY RETIREMENT
FOR AGE
WHEREAS, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Henry Clarke
Hill , Warden of the United States Penitentiary , Lewisburg, Pennsylvania , who
was exempted from compulsory retirement for age for a period not in excess of one
year from March 1, 1939, by Executive Order No. 8041 of January 25, 1939 , be
further exempted from compulsory retirement for a period not in excess of six months
from March 1 , 1940 :
NOW, THEREFORE , by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me
by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382 , 404 (U. S. C., title 5, sec.
715a) , I hereby further exempt the said Henry Clarke Hill from compulsory retire￾ment for age for a period not in excess of six months from March 1 , 1940 .
FRANKLIN D ROOSEVELT
THE WHITE HOUSE,
January 22, 194
